channel.title: CallGuard AI briefings
channel.description: Briefings on call compliance for FCA-regulated protection and mortgage advice firms.

item.title: Vulnerable customer call monitoring: what FG21/1 actually expects
item.dc:creator: Charlotte Court
item.description: FG21/1 is guidance, not a rulebook, which makes it harder to evidence rather than easier. The FCA's 2025 review named the hard case precisely: vulnerability that is detectable but never disclosed. That happens out loud, on the call.

item.title: PECR and TPS in 2026: practical compliance for outbound teams
item.dc:creator: Charlotte Court
item.description: What's tightened, what's blurred, and the five things the ICO will ask if a PECR complaint reaches them. Plus the systematic-monitoring standard that has replaced sample-based QA.

item.title: AI vs human call scoring: when each makes sense
item.dc:creator: Kofi Vickery
item.description: An honest comparison from someone selling AI scoring tooling. What AI is genuinely better at, what humans still beat AI on, and the right division of labour for production QA teams.

item.title: FCA Consumer Duty: 7 things your call recordings need to evidence
item.dc:creator: Charlotte Court
item.description: A practical checklist for compliance leads at FCA-regulated firms. The four outcomes, the evidence the regulator actually expects on a recording, and why a 5% sample no longer cuts it.

item.title: How to score 100% of contact centre calls without hiring more QA staff
item.dc:creator: Kofi Vickery
item.description: The QA bottleneck explained from first principles, the maths of manual versus AI scoring, and what the architecture of 100% coverage actually looks like in production.

item.title: What is AI call QA and how does it actually work?
item.dc:creator: Kofi Vickery
item.description: A plain-English walkthrough of how speech recognition, large language models and per-tenant calibration combine to score every call your team takes against your scorecard.
